column1: Inflation: The Phillips Curve Inflation in this economy is determined by a conventional Phillips curve augmented to include roles for expected inflation and exogenous supply shocks. The equation for inflation is pt 5 Et 1pt 1 f(Yt Y – t ) 1 yt . This piece of the model is similar to the Phillips curve and short-run aggregate supply equation introduced in Chapter 14. According to this equation, inflation pt depends on previously expected inflation Et 1pt , the deviation of output from its natural level (Yt Y – t ), and an exogenous supply shock yt .
